judge.description: A low camera looks down a long straight obstacle run of glossy coloured tiles that mirror the obstacles (screen-space reflections), past a striped inflatable hammer in sharp focus on the right, clear-coated pads and an inflatable arch, ice blocks, a furry plush ball, glowing neon tube arches, a liquid strip beside the run and particles in the air, to a row of tall pillars with light shafts between them and big distant shapes fading into haze. The far run is softly out of focus (depth of field) and the colours are graded. Expected: simple procedural shapes and no characters; score the mood, gloss, depth haze and grading. Target ref-3: a humid green jungle, warm low sun through the pillars, lime and yellow inflatables, a brown mud strip with splashes, thick green humid haze.
judge.output:
JUDGE FAIL: 3.0/10 (minimum 6.0) on proofs/captures/lookdev/m14-camera-effects--world-jungle.png by claude-haiku-5-5 (median of [3.0, 3.0, 3.0])
expected: A low camera looks down a long straight obstacle run of glossy coloured tiles that mirror the obstacles (screen-space reflections), past a striped inflatable hammer in sharp focus on the right, clear-coated pads and an inflatable arch, ice blocks, a furry plush ball, glowing neon tube arches, a liquid strip beside the run and particles in the air, to a row of tall pillars with light shafts between them and big distant shapes fading into haze. The far run is softly out of focus (depth of field) and the colours are graded. Expected: simple procedural shapes and no characters; score the mood, gloss, depth haze and grading. Target ref-3: a humid green jungle, warm low sun through the pillars, lime and yellow inflatables, a brown mud strip with splashes, thick green humid haze.
seen: The frame is washed out by a uniform yellow haze with no jungle greens, mud strip or saturated grading. Shapes are plain procedural forms (a sphere, flat tile grid, a faint striped hammer, blurry pillars) with little gloss or material detail compared with the reference, and the pillars and far shapes are barely legible. Some elements are present (neon arch, glossy tiles, a side strip with particles), but the overall finish is far cruder than the reference.
